title: Prove concave Coxeter batch tariffs with a sharp chronology gap (no κ)
body:
The rank-priced Coxeter theorem leaves concave higher-rank invocation prices outside its scope. This isolated package proves a packed orbitwise lower bound and sharp batch tariffs, then shows that chronology can force a strict correction to the packed floor.

For three copies of `st` in A2 with paid rank at most two and prices `0 <= c1 <= c2 <= 2c1`, the exact cost is **2c1 + 2c2**. The root-rank packing bound gives only **3c2**. At `f(k)=k/(k+1)`, the exact bill is `7/3`, above the root floor `2`. Every three-call word has an `[st]` coefficient that factors through a rank-at-most-two scalar coupling, while the target coefficient has rank three. A four-call `(2,1,2,1)` word attains the price.

More generally, for cap b and root-orbit prices f, the bound is `sum_O [floor(M_O/b) f_O(b) + f_O(M_O mod b)]`. Identical targets on d productive roles attain it when b divides d; a single-reflection target attains it for every d. These are written formal-model theorems over every field, with free scalar GL mixing and any finite number of restored dirty spectators. Arbitrary rank-capped scalar couplings are allowed, including non-idempotents.

Only `research/coxeter-capped-concave-tariff/` is added. No new kappa, native primitive, supplier admission or selected-frontier change is claimed. All five selected assumptions remain. Native routing/storage/mixing/precision/restoration costs and general nondivisible or heterogeneous optimality remain open. No subagents were used.

It already settles the different three-target longest-element cap-two schedule. It is pinned and credited, not repackaged or called an open problem. The new chronological target is `st`. PR6613 changes the monomial reflection alphabet at unit prices and is related context only. PR6811 and PR6812 are not resumed or repackaged.

- Registered normal/optimized replay and three executable mathematical mutations in both modes pass. Direct CPython 3.10.12 normal/optimized replay also passes with identical counts.
- 14,010 packing optima; 4,872 arbitrary-coupling gate checks; 1,440 product-cut inequalities; 672 full formal batch endpoints over F2/F3/F5; 2,655 dirty-gauged calls; 588 rejecting omission controls.
- New chronology result: eight signed noncommutative coefficient expansions, three exact full four-call endpoints and 21 exact price-profile optima.
- Metadata/pins, committed bytes/modes, source-history ancestry, official export integrity and Git-free read-only exported replay pass. No exported bytes changed. `git diff --check` passes.

Finite checks corroborate the written proof; they do not enumerate all circuits or prove the multiplication theorem. No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, independent human review or proof-kernel review was run. Hosted CI is separate from this local evidence and scientific acceptance.
